title: Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B via Ollama
slug_note: A small NVIDIA assistant model built on Gemma 4 E4B; 7-8 GB tag.

variation.quant_detail: Q4_K_M, Ollama's `nemotron-3.5-bolt:e4b` tag, 7.2GB - 7.9GB (with the vision projector); quant and 65,536 context read with `ollama show` on our DGX Spark
variation.revision_note: Ollama model ID shown by `ollama list` on the Spark when measured (2026-10-24)

requirements.notes: Measured on a DGX Spark: 17.7 GB resident at Ollama's default 64K context (weights + KV). Smaller boxes get a smaller default context and less KV. Earlier estimate: Estimate from the tag size plus KV headroom. Not measured.

steps.text: Install Ollama (see Step 0 in Quick start).

measurements.method: spark_bench.py via the Ollama API, Ollama 0.40.10, single stream, fresh nonce per run so every prefill is cold, one warm-up run discarded, 256 output tokens, median of 3; 638-token prompt
spark_bench.py via the Ollama API, Ollama 0.40.10, single stream, fresh nonce per run so every prefill is cold, one warm-up run discarded, 256 output tokens, median of 3; 4670-token prompt

spark_bench.py via the Ollama API, Ollama 0.40.10, single stream, fresh nonce per run so every prefill is cold, one warm-up run discarded, 256 output tokens, median of 3; 4670-token prompt, Ollama prompt_eval timing
drop in MemAvailable from cold (OS file cache dropped) to loaded after `ollama run nemotron-3.5-bolt:e4b`, at the default context Ollama chose (65536 tokens)

caveats: Ollama 0.40.10 on a 128 GB DGX Spark picked a 64K default context by itself, so memory use is well above the file size. Set num_ctx lower to save memory, or keep it for long documents.
No speed or memory numbers recorded yet; the size is Ollama's listed tag size.
Context: `ollama show` reports 65,536 tokens, matching NVIDIA's card (64K input); the Ollama library page says 128K.
Works as written on a DGX Spark (2026-10-24): `ollama run nemotron-3.5-bolt:e4b` answered after 10.7 s from a cold start (model files read from disk).

sources.note: NVIDIA card: 8B (4B effective), built on Gemma-4-E4B
